title: Token Atelier: Reticle export & role-aware cost reticle prototype
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, export-first token-level cost view ("reticle") that combines attribution overlays, session-sparkline thumbnails, and role-aware CSV templates. This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, review cycle with PM/Eng, and CSV/JSON export schema that maps to the pricing presets. Goal: provide a low-friction export flow for finance/platform teams to extract per-invocation cost slices and pricing scenario inputs for batch analysis and chargeback.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype covering: grid view, attribution overlay, sparkline thumbnails, export modal with template presets
Export modal supports CSV and JSON, with role-aware column presets (Admin, Billing, Developer) and a compact CSV-first layout
Mapping doc for token attribution fields (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, model_id, quant_mode, batching_factor, route) reviewed and approved by Eng
Prototype validated in design review and PM sign-off, with a small usability session (3 participants) showing task success for 'download per-session CSV for billing'
PRD includes explicit fallback behavior for rollouts: fallback to per-route cost tile when reticle data missing, and guidance for canary-enabled exports
design_links: Figma frames: Grid / Reticle / Export modal / Template presets
Prototype: interactive CSV export flow with sample data
Spec artboard: attribution overlay motion + tooltip copy
related_prs: GH-2149: feat(cost): export reticle CSV templates
GH-2187: perf: compact payload for export pipeline
comments: 2025-02-10 Maya Chen: Kickoff — sketched the initial 'reticle' metaphor: a compact grid card per session that expands into attribution overlays. Focus is export-first; CSV layout prioritized for finance ingestion.

2025-02-14 Luca Fernandez: UX spike completed — investigated existing cost tile components and re-used the microledger card. Raised question about pagination vs sampling for large exports ( >100k rows ).
2025-02-18 Priya Nair (PM): PM review — asked to add a 'pricing scenario' toggle to let users export with or without applied discounts/commits. Also requested label for 'estimated vs billed' columns.

2025-02-21 Eng notes (Marcus Lee): Eng feedback — backend will emit a slightly different attribution key for KV cache hits (kv_cache_hit:true). We need to include a normalized column name 'kv_hit' and doc mapping. Also flagged that quantization profile is not present in current telemetry; Eng will add an opt-in flag in runtime-1.18.

2025-02-25 Design update: Incorporated pricing scenario toggle and role-aware presets (Admin = verbose, Billing = compact with account and SKU, Developer = debug fields). Updated Figma prototype and CSV sample files.

2025-03-03 Usability session: 3 participants (2 finance, 1 platform) — key finding: finance expects a 'line-item rate' column per invocation for downstream chargebacks. Added that to acceptance criteria.

2025-03-08 Design review: Feedback from Design Lead (Anika Patel) — reduce visual density for default reticle, collapse sparkline thumbnails behind an affordance. Approved export modal copy and CTA hierarchy.
2025-03-10 Eng review: Marcus Lee — PR GH-2149 created. Backend agreed on CSV schema but requested 2-week runway to add quant_mode. We added a migration note to PR.
2025-03-12 PM sign-off: Priya Nair — sign-off pending final schema doc and a short integration test from Eng. Marking ticket In Review.
decisions: Adopt 'CSV-first' mental model for export — default to CSV with compact columns for Billing preset
Introduce role-aware presets (Admin, Billing, Developer) implemented client-side as column/format templates
Include a 'pricing scenario' toggle (list: raw, committed-pricing, negotiated-discount) applied to exported numeric columns
Fallback behavior: if token-level reticle rows are incomplete, fall back to per-route aggregate export and surface a warning in modal
tradeoffs: Including many debug fields increases export size — chose role-presets to balance verbosity vs ingestability
Providing live preview of exported CSV increases client CPU for very large result sets — limited preview to first 500 rows
Real-time enrichment (e.g., map account SKUs) requires backend joins — deferred enrichment to export pipeline to keep UI responsive
next_steps: Final schema doc to Eng (owner: Marcus Lee) — due 2025-03-15
Add migration note to GH-2149 and request integration test for quant_mode and kv_hit fields
Design QA pass: reduce reticle default density and add collapsible sparkline affordance
Schedule rollout plan with platform: canary export in dedicated region + monitoring dashboard for export job failures
Prepare export CSV sample set (3 variations) for Customer Support and Finance onboarding
notes_for_engineering: Provide opt-in telemetry for quant_mode by runtime-1.18 (Eng owner: Marcus)
API: /exports/reticle should accept template=presetName and pricing_scenario=raw|committed|discounted
Export should stream CSV gzip for large payloads and include a manifest JSON with column schema
